The treatment system consists of influent screening and grit removal
biological removal of biochemical oxygen demand (BOD) and nitrogen in aerobic, anoxic, and pre-anoxic basins
All solids transferred from the biological process to the interchange tanks are first passed through a 250 micron rotary drum screen
The Permittee uses a proprietary solids removal and digestion process that combines aerobic and anaerobic processes
digested solids are pumped from the interchange reactor tanks, dosed with polymer for thickening, and then dewatered in a centrifuge
All solids are then transported for disposal at Redwood Landfill in Marin County or Hay Road Landfill in Solano County
The Facility includes a 5 million gallon aerated influent equalization basin and a 3.35 million gallon equalization basin
